title: 沉管水下對接與止水
summary: 本課以沉管接頭幾何、壓縮接觸與雙重水密屏障為主線，從端面姿態與初始接觸與主密封壓縮與反力曲線建立系統邊界，再把溫度伸縮與軸向位移、剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心連到屏障獨立性與交接檔案。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on immersed-joint geometry, compression contact and dual sealing barriers. It begins with End-face attitude and initial contact and Primary-seal compression and reaction curves, links Thermal expansion and axial movement and Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact, and ends with Barrier independence and handover records. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「端面姿態與初始接觸」與「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "End-face attitude and initial contact" and "Primary-seal compression and reaction curves": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: End-face attitude and initial contact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「端面姿態與初始接觸」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “End-face attitude and initial contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接頭兩端面並非只需中心對準，偏航、俯仰和翹曲會使密封圈局部先接觸。第一接觸點承受的壓縮可能遠大於平均值，因而幾何差應沿整個周邊呈現；剛體角差模型只識別不均勻性，不能給出橡膠反力分布。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序；若出現中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「端面姿態與初始接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Coincident centers do not ensure matching end faces: yaw, pitch and warping create early local seal contact. The first contact can compress far more than the average, so map mismatch around the perimeter. A rigid-angle model identifies nonuniformity but cannot determine rubber reaction distribution. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. If acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “End-face attitude and initial contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「端面姿態與初始接觸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “End-face attitude and initial contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸
knowledge.text: 接頭兩端面並非只需中心對準，偏航、俯仰和翹曲會使密封圈局部先接觸。第一接觸點承受的壓縮可能遠大於平均值，因而幾何差應沿整個周邊呈現；剛體角差模型只識別不均勻性，不能給出橡膠反力分布。
knowledge.textEn: Coincident centers do not ensure matching end faces: yaw, pitch and warping create early local seal contact. The first contact can compress far more than the average, so map mismatch around the perimeter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「沉管水下對接與止水」的「端面姿態與初始接觸：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「都會地下工區協調」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “End-face attitude and initial contact: mechanism and system paths” in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban underground coordination” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「端面姿態與初始接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "End-face attitude and initial contact" is correct?
options: 兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸
接頭兩端面並非只需中心對準，偏航、俯仰和翹曲會使密封圈局部先接觸。
橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同
optionsEn: Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal
Coincident centers do not ensure matching end faces: yaw, pitch and warping create early local seal contact.
Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile
quiz.explanation: 接頭兩端面並非只需中心對準，偏航、俯仰和翹曲會使密封圈局部先接觸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Coincident centers do not ensure matching end faces: yaw, pitch and warping create early local seal contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: End-face attitude and initial contact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「端面姿態與初始接觸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “End-face attitude and initial contact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「端面姿態與初始接觸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "End-face attitude and initial contact", which statement holds?

steps.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: End-face attitude and initial contact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「端面姿態與初始接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “End-face attitude and initial contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

If acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「端面姿態與初始接觸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "End-face attitude and initial contact"?
options: 比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷
optionsEn: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free
quiz.explanation: 比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: End-face attitude and initial contact: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「端面姿態與初始接觸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “End-face attitude and initial contact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序；若出現中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「端面姿態與初始接觸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。

橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other.
Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile

quiz.explanationEn: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 主密封壓縮與反力曲線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Primary-seal compression and reaction curves: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Gina 類主密封利用端面壓縮建立接觸，但空心斷面與材料非線性使反力不會簡單正比壓縮率。製造商試驗曲線應對應實際斷面和溫度，接縫、轉角及長期鬆弛另行評估；幾何壓縮率只能作版本與尺寸核對。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對；若出現借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Gina-type primary seal develops contact through end compression, but hollow geometry and nonlinear rubber prevent reaction from scaling directly with compression ratio. Match manufacturer tests to the profile and temperature and assess corners, splices and relaxation separately. A geometric ratio checks dimensions and configuration only. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. If using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Match manufacturer tests to the profile and temperature and assess corners, splices and relaxation separately.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

外水壓乘全部濕表面就等於接頭軸向合攏力

External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force
A Gina-type primary seal develops contact through end compression, but hollow geometry and nonlinear rubber prevent reaction from scaling directly with compression ratio.

quiz.explanationEn: A Gina-type primary seal develops contact through end compression, but hollow geometry and nonlinear rubber prevent reaction from scaling directly with compression ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主密封壓縮與反力曲線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Primary-seal compression and reaction curves: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 主密封壓縮與反力曲線：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Primary-seal compression and reaction curves: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 在「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Primary-seal compression and reaction curves" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
外水壓乘全部濕表面就等於接頭軸向合攏力
借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force
Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity.
quiz.explanation: 借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
